meta.parties: The Government Agent,Western Province v. Palaniappa Chetty

rules.statement: A donor in a deed of gift may reserve to himself the power to revoke the gift, and such a revocation is valid.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is lawful for the donor in a deed of gift to reserve to himself the power to revoke the gift; and a revocation made in the exercise of such power is valid."
